status: RECONSTRUCTED APPROXIMATION, not the authors' library
paper: Theile et al. (2026), Supply Chain Risk and Resolution
selection_rationale: Windowed PPMI + truncated SVD on the phrase-augmented corpus, multiword seeds resolved to their joined phrase token. Chosen on outcome-blind criteria only: smallest vocabulary of any arm at 254 against the paper's 208; the most stable vocabulary under both a different random seed (Jaccard 0.864) and a 50% corpus subsample (0.791); the highest lenient blinded precision (0.873); joint-lowest generic-term count; cosine ordering agreement rho=0.655, statistically indistinguishable from the best arm's 0.667. It trails the CBOW arm by exactly one Table 2 term (27/30 vs 28/30) and misses 'customer', which is the paper's second most frequent keyword. That single deficit is outweighed by a vocabulary 100 terms smaller and materially more reproducible.
outcome_blind_note: No CAR, transcript score, quintile return, or any downstream result was computed, inspected, or available while this vocabulary was chosen. Selection used only Table 2 recovery, cosine ordering, blinded semantic precision, stability, per-seed coverage, frequency support, generic-language avoidance, and final size.

random_seeds.corpus_sampling_scheme: random.Random(f'{seed}:{year}') per year, sample() over accession-sorted pool

environments.word2vec_only: dap-w2v (Python 3.13, gensim 4.4.0) because gensim does not build on Python 3.14
